_comment: The sidebar's Getting started guide, one step per entry, shown in order. Write to the player in a friendly, plain voice: two or three short sentences, 45 words at most (the card is as tall as the longest step). 'text' is HTML; use <b> only for the panel's own labels. 'target' names the sidebar component to highlight (its setName), or bankButton for the bank's title-bar button; leave it out for none. 'done' moves the guide on when the player does it: target (picks a monster), bank (opens the gear layout), or opens a view: fight (Assumptions), gear (Rules), settings, or results (Back to results). checks every target resolves.

steps.title: Welcome!
steps.text: This quick tour shows you how to find the best gear for any fight. Each step highlights the part of the panel it's talking about. Do what it says and the tour keeps up with you, or click Next to skip ahead.

steps.title: Open your bank once
steps.text: First, open your bank while logged in. The plugin can only use gear it knows you have, and it finds out from your bank. With Dude, Where's My Stuff? on, gear in your STASH units, POH and other storage counts too.

steps.title: Pick a monster
steps.text: Now type a monster's name, like Vorkath, and click it in the list. The search starts straight away and takes a moment, or a few seconds for big bosses. In game, you can also right-click a monster and choose Best setup.

steps.title: Pick the version
steps.text: Some bosses change form or come in a few versions, like Verzik's three phases. When they do, a Version list appears here so you can pick the one you're fighting. Most monsters only have one, so don't worry if it's hidden.

steps.title: Choose your gear
steps.text: Pick what gear to work with: Owned items only, just what you're carrying (Inventory + equipped only), what you own plus upgrades up to a budget (Owned + budget), or anything (Best in slot). Change it and the result updates.

steps.title: Read your result
steps.text: Each attack style gets its own tab, strongest first. You'll see the gear and inventory to bring, your DPS, max hit and kill time, the special attack and prayer to use, trip supplies, and the cost of anything you'd need to buy.

steps.title: Compare attack styles
steps.text: These icons are the attack styles that work here: stab, slash, crush, ranged, magic and the atlatl. Click one to see its best setup. The strongest is first, and your pick stays put when the search runs again.

steps.title: Pick your styles
steps.text: Never use stab, or not training Magic yet? You can switch styles off so the search skips them. Open Settings to see how.

steps.title: Attack styles
steps.text: Open Attack styles and untick any style you don't want: Stab, Slash, Crush, Ranged, Magic or Atlatl. Prevent manual casting keeps Magic to autocast spells; turn it off to let the search cast by hand with any weapon.

steps.title: What counts as best
steps.text: Search options changes what the search aims for. Optimise for picks DPS, accuracy, max hit or average hit, Weapon hands keeps to one- or two-handed weapons, and Use special attacks mixes the best specs into each kill.

steps.title: Back to your result
steps.text: Every change here updates the result straight away. Click Back to results when you're done.

steps.title: Describe the fight
steps.text: Assumptions tells the search about the fight itself, the things it can't tell from the monster alone. Open it and we'll go through it.

steps.title: Fight conditions
steps.text: Set Your HP if you'll fight below full, which matters for Dharok's and ruby bolts. Slayer task on Auto checks your task for you. Enable AoE compares total damage against a group of enemies in multicombat.

steps.title: Wilderness and targets
steps.text: In Wilderness plans a Wilderness fight with revenant weapon bonuses, and Limit expensive items caps what you risk. Active encounter follows whatever you attack and searches again whenever your target changes.

steps.title: Your trip
steps.text: Kills per trip sizes your food, potions and prayer for one trip. Spec energy is Regenerating for back-to-back kills or a Full bar for a single kill, and Fill inventory with food packs the free slots.

steps.title: Raids and drains
steps.text: Raid bosses add Raid scaling: party size, ToA raid level or CoX Challenge Mode. Pre-fight preparation counts defence drains landed before the fight, like Dragon warhammer or Elder maul hits, or Use active defence reads them as you land them.

steps.title: Back again
steps.text: Click Back to results. The result has already caught up with everything you changed.

steps.title: Your rules
steps.text: Rules keeps everything you've told the search to always or never use. Right-clicking an item, prayer or spell in a result adds one too. Open it to have a look.

steps.title: Lock an item
steps.text: Locked items makes the search always use an item in its slot, or keep a slot empty. Pick a slot, search for the item and click it. The × on a rule removes it.

steps.title: Exclude an item
steps.text: Excluded items are never used, not even as a boost. Handy for gear you've lent out or are saving for something else. Search for an item to add it.

steps.title: Prayers and spells
steps.text: Click any prayer under Excluded prayers you can't or won't use. Allowed spells limits Magic to the spells you list, and Excluded spells are never cast.

steps.title: Gear the bank can't see
steps.text: Own something your bank doesn't show, like an outfit in your POH costume room? Add it under Extra owned items so the search can use it.

steps.title: Back to it
steps.text: Click Back to results to see your setup with your rules applied.

steps.title: Lay out your bank
steps.text: With a result showing, open your bank and click the highlighted crossed-swords button at the top (Gear layout). Your bank then shows just the setup, laid out the way you'd carry it. Click it again to see everything.

steps.title: Gear up
steps.text: While a setup is selected, its items are outlined in your bank and inventory, so it's easy to spot what to take out and put on. You can turn the outlines off or change their colour in Settings.

steps.title: Keep it up to date
steps.text: Changing a setting updates the result by itself. New gear, levels and prices don't, so after a bank trip or a level-up, click Search again to catch up.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Settings also has equipment, experience filters, boosts, highlights and the panel's look. That's the tour! Click Done to finish, and the ? next to the title brings it back any time.
